name: Muse Wonder
description: Muse Wonder is a proprietary reasoning model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, released on October 12, 2026 for personal and professional agents and long-running coding tasks. Active Memory retains relevant context across interactions, and Active Focus supports sustained task execution and error recovery. Muse Wonder accepts text, images, video, audio, and PDFs and produces text with a 1,048,576-token context window. It is available through the Meta Model API as muse-wonder-1.0 and in Muse Code.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis
benchmarks.description: Artificial Analysis benchmark evaluates AI models across quality, speed, and pricing dimensions, providing a composite assessment of model capabilities for real-world usage.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Meta Muse Wonder model card, October 12, 2026; max reasoning effort. Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, independently evaluated by Artificial Analysis and reproduced in Meta's model card. Reported on a 0-100 scale, stored as a fraction.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench-AA
benchmarks.description: AutomationBench-AA is Artificial Analysis's independently run version of AutomationBench, covering 657 real-world SaaS workflow tasks across 40 simulated applications (e.g. Gmail, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot). It scores the share of objectives an agent completes without violating business guardrails, using a private held-out task set.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Meta Muse Wonder model card, October 12, 2026; max reasoning effort. Artificial Analysis strict pass@1; every deterministic end-state assertion must pass. Reported on a 0-100 scale, stored as a fraction.

benchmarks.name: Program Bench
benchmarks.description: Program Bench evaluates code-generation agents by asking them to recreate a program's behavior from only a compiled binary and documentation. It spans 200 tasks from small CLI tools to large systems such as FFmpeg and SQLite, with submissions judged against more than 248,000 fuzz-generated behavioral tests.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Meta Muse Wonder model card, October 12, 2026; max reasoning effort. All models use mini-swe-agent; share of rollouts passing at least 95% of hidden behavioral tests; internet disabled after setup. Reported on a 0-100 scale, stored as a fraction.

benchmarks.name: SWE-Marathon
benchmarks.description: SWE-Marathon is an ultra-long-horizon software engineering benchmark covering tasks such as building compilers, optimizing kernels, and developing production-grade services. It measures whether agents can sustain quality across extremely long engineering trajectories.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Meta Muse Wonder model card, October 12, 2026; max reasoning effort. Abundant AI pass@1 results on long-running software projects. External results retain their reporting harnesses; not a controlled common-harness comparison. Reported on a 0-100 scale, stored as a fraction.
